extensionDescription.message: Shows when your requests go through an intermediary that decrypts them, such as Cloudflare, Akamai or Imperva.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager.

titleNeutral.message: No request seen in this tab goes through a known intermediary.
titleNeutral.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when no request seen in the tab goes through a known provider.

titleNotObserved.message: Site not observed: the extension's access to this site was withdrawn, so it can say nothing about it.
titleNotObserved.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when the extension has no access to the site of the tab and saw nothing.

countLevel2One.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 2, blue, when there is one.

countLevel2Many.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 2, blue, when there are several.

countLevel3ProvenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, red, when there is one.

countLevel3ProvenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, red, when there are several.

countLevel3UnprovenOne.message: Level 3, reading: 1 request, decryption not proven
countLevel3UnprovenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, orange, when there is one.

countLevel3UnprovenMany.message: Level 3, reading: $COUNT$ requests, decryption not proven
countLevel3UnprovenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, orange, when there are several.

countLevel4ProvenOne.message: Level 4, personal data: 1 request, decryption proven
countLevel4ProvenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, red, when there is one.

countLevel4ProvenMany.message: Level 4, personal data: $COUNT$ requests, decryption proven
countLevel4ProvenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, red, when there are several.

countLevel4UnprovenOne.message: Level 4, personal data: 1 request, decryption not proven
countLevel4UnprovenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, orange, when there is one.

countLevel4UnprovenMany.message: Level 4, personal data: $COUNT$ requests, decryption not proven
countLevel4UnprovenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, orange, when there are several.

titleLevel2.message: Usage: $PROVIDER$ sees which public resources this site makes you load, and when.
titleLevel2.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: blue, level 2.

titleLevel3Unproven.message: Reading: the pages you read go through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel3Unproven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: orange, level 3.

titleLevel3Proven.message: Reading: the pages you read go through $PROVIDER$ in clear.
titleLevel3Proven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: red, level 3.

titleLevel4DataSentUnproven.message: Data sent: what your browser sends goes through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel4DataSentUnproven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: orange, level 4, case of a request that sends data.

titleLevel4DataSentProven.message: Data sent: what your browser sends goes through $PROVIDER$ in clear.
titleLevel4DataSentProven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: red, level 4, case of a request that sends data.

titleLevel4SessionUnproven.message: Session: your session on this site goes through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear.
titleLevel4SessionUnproven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: orange, level 4, case of a request that carries an Authorization header.

titleLevel4SessionProven.message: Session: your session on this site goes through $PROVIDER$ in clear.
titleLevel4SessionProven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: red, level 4, case of a request that carries an Authorization header.

titleLevel4SessionPossibleUnproven.message: Possible session: the cookies you send to this site go through $PROVIDER$, perhaps in clear, and one of them may hold your session.
titleLevel4SessionPossibleUnproven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: orange, level 4, case of a request that carries cookies of the site.

titleLevel4SessionPossibleProven.message: Possible session: the cookies you send to this site go through $PROVIDER$ in clear, and one of them may hold your session.
titleLevel4SessionPossibleProven.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the most serious request of the tab means: red, level 4, case of a request that carries cookies of the site.

titleAntiBot.message: Anti-bot: the most serious request belongs to the anti-bot protection of $PROVIDER$, not to the site you visit.
titleAntiBot.description: Line added to the tooltip when the most serious request belongs to the anti-bot machinery of the provider.

titlePartial.message: Partial view: the extension does not have access to every site, so it shows only what it saw.
titlePartial.description: Line added to the tooltip when the extension lacks the access to all sites.
